The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1898–1899''' was contested by twelve teams participating in two divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off match featuring the winners of the eastern and western football division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[RAP (football club)|RAP]] won this year's championship by beating [[EFC PW 1885|PW Enschede]] 3-2 and 2–1.

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*[[Koninklijke UD|U.D.]]
*[[Quick Nijmegen]]

'''Eerste Klasse West:'''
*[[Koninklijke HFC]] returned after one season of absence
